001package com.streamconverter.examples;
002
003import com.streamConverter.StreamConverter;
004import com.streamConverter.command.IStreamCommand;
005import java.io.ByteArrayInputStream;
006import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;
007import java.io.IOException;
008import java.io.InputStream;
009import java.io.OutputStream;
010import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
011import java.util.concurrent.CountDownLatch;
012import java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService;
013import java.util.concurrent.Executors;
014import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit;
015import org.slf4j.Logger;
016import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
017import org.slf4j.MDC;
018
019/**
020 * MDCのマルチスレッド環境での動作検証のための実装例
021 *
022 * <p>このクラスでは以下の検証を行います： 1. 単一スレッドでのMDC動作 2. 複数スレッドでのMDC分離性 3. StreamConverterのマルチスレッドパイプラインでのMDC継承
023 * 4. Thread-Local性の確認
024 */
025public class MDCMultiThreadExample {
026  private static final Logger logger = LoggerFactory.getLogger(MDCMultiThreadExample.class);
027
028  /**
029   * メインメソッド
030   *
031   * @param args コマンドライン引数
032   */
033  public static void main(String[] args) {
034    logger.info("🧪 MDC Multi-Thread Behavior Test");
035    logger.info("=================================\n");
036
037    try {
038      // テスト1: 単一スレッドでのMDC動作確認
039      demonstrateSingleThreadMDC();
040      Thread.sleep(1000); // ログ出力の区切りのため
041
042      // テスト2: 複数スレッドでのMDC分離性確認
043      demonstrateMultiThreadMDCIsolation();
044      Thread.sleep(1000);
045
046      // テスト3: StreamConverterパイプラインでのMDC動作確認
047      demonstrateStreamConverterMDC();
048      Thread.sleep(1000);
049
050      // テスト4: MDCの継承性とクリーンアップ確認
051      demonstrateMDCInheritanceAndCleanup();
052
053    } catch (Exception e) {
054      logger.error("MDC demonstration failed: {}", e.getMessage(), e);
055    }
056  }
057
058  /** テスト1: 単一スレッドでのMDC動作確認 */
059  private static void demonstrateSingleThreadMDC() {
060    logger.info("📝 Test 1: Single Thread MDC Behavior");
061    logger.info("Current thread: {}", Thread.currentThread().getName());
062
063    // MDCにコンテキスト情報を設定
064    MDC.put("testCase", "single-thread");
065    MDC.put("userId", "user123");
066    MDC.put("sessionId", "session456");
067
068    logger.info("MDC values set for single thread");
069    logger.debug("Debugging in single thread context");
070    logger.warn("Warning message with MDC context");
071
072    // MDCクリア
073    MDC.clear();
074    logger.info("MDC cleared - this log should not have context");
075    logger.info("Test 1 completed\n");
076  }
077
078  /** テスト2: 複数スレッドでのMDC分離性確認 */
079  private static void demonstrateMultiThreadMDCIsolation() throws InterruptedException {
080    logger.info("🔀 Test 2: Multi-Thread MDC Isolation");
081
082    ExecutorService executor = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(3);
083    CountDownLatch latch = new CountDownLatch(3);
084
085    // 3つの異なるスレッドでMDCを設定
086    for (int i = 1; i <= 3; i++) {
087      final int threadId = i;
088      executor.submit(
089          () -> {
090            try {
091              // 各スレッドで異なるMDC値を設定
092              MDC.put("testCase", "multi-thread-isolation");
093              MDC.put("threadId", "thread-" + threadId);
094              MDC.put("taskId", "task-" + threadId + "-" + System.currentTimeMillis());
095
096              logger.info("Thread {} started with MDC context", threadId);
097
098              // 処理時間をシミュレート
099              Thread.sleep(100 + (threadId * 50));
100
101              logger.info("Thread {} processing data", threadId);
102              logger.warn("Thread {} encountered warning", threadId);
103              logger.info("Thread {} completed", threadId);
104
105              // MDCクリア
106              MDC.clear();
107              logger.info("Thread {} MDC cleared", threadId);
108
109            } catch (InterruptedException e) {
110              Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
111              logger.error("Thread {} interrupted", threadId);
112            } finally {
113              latch.countDown();
114            }
115          });
116    }
117
118    latch.await(10, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
119    executor.shutdown();
120    logger.info("Test 2 completed\n");
121  }
122
123  /** テスト3: StreamConverterパイプラインでのMDC動作確認 */
124  private static void demonstrateStreamConverterMDC() throws IOException {
125    logger.info("🔄 Test 3: StreamConverter Pipeline MDC Behavior");
126
127    // テストデータ
128    String testData = "id,name,value\n1,test1,100\n2,test2,200\n";
129
130    // MDC設定コマンドを作成
131    IStreamCommand mdcSetupCommand = createMDCSetupCommand("pipeline-test");
132    IStreamCommand processingCommand1 = createMDCProcessingCommand("stage1");
133    IStreamCommand processingCommand2 = createMDCProcessingCommand("stage2");
134    IStreamCommand mdcCleanupCommand = createMDCCleanupCommand();
135
136    // パイプライン作成
137    StreamConverter converter =
138        StreamConverter.create(
139            mdcSetupCommand, processingCommand1, processingCommand2, mdcCleanupCommand);
140
141    ByteArrayInputStream inputStream =
142        new ByteArrayInputStream(testData.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
143    ByteArrayOutputStream outputStream = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
144
145    logger.info("Executing StreamConverter pipeline with MDC");
146    converter.run(inputStream, outputStream);
147
148    String result = outputStream.toString(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
149    logger.info("Pipeline result length: {} characters", result.length());
150    logger.info("Test 3 completed\n");
151  }
152
153  /** テスト4: MDCの継承性とクリーンアップ確認 */
154  private static void demonstrateMDCInheritanceAndCleanup() throws InterruptedException {
155    logger.info("🧹 Test 4: MDC Inheritance and Cleanup");
156
157    // メインスレッドでMDCを設定
158    MDC.put("testCase", "inheritance-test");
159    MDC.put("mainThreadId", Thread.currentThread().getName());
160    MDC.put("parentContext", "main-context");
161
162    logger.info("Main thread MDC setup complete");
163
164    ExecutorService executor = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor();
165    CountDownLatch latch = new CountDownLatch(1);
166
167    executor.submit(
168        () -> {
169          try {
170            // 子スレッドでMDCの状態を確認
171            logger.info("Child thread started - checking MDC inheritance");
172
173            String inheritedTestCase = MDC.get("testCase");
174            if (inheritedTestCase != null) {
175              logger.warn("UNEXPECTED: Child thread inherited MDC value: {}", inheritedTestCase);
176            } else {
177              logger.info("EXPECTED: Child thread has clean MDC context");
178            }
179
180            // 子スレッドで独自のMDCを設定
181            MDC.put("testCase", "child-thread-test");
182            MDC.put("childThreadId", Thread.currentThread().getName());
183
184            logger.info("Child thread set its own MDC context");
185            logger.debug("Child thread debug message");
186
187            // MDCクリア
188            MDC.clear();
189            logger.info("Child thread cleared its MDC");
190
191          } finally {
192            latch.countDown();
193          }
194        });
195
196    latch.await(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
197    executor.shutdown();
198
199    // メインスレッドのMDCが影響を受けていないかチェック
200    logger.info("Back in main thread - checking MDC state");
201    String mainTestCase = MDC.get("testCase");
202    if (mainTestCase != null) {
203      logger.info("Main thread MDC preserved: {}", mainTestCase);
204    } else {
205      logger.warn("Main thread MDC was affected by child thread");
206    }
207
208    MDC.clear();
209    logger.info("Test 4 completed - all MDC cleared");
210  }
211
212  /** MDC設定用のコマンドを作成 */
213  private static IStreamCommand createMDCSetupCommand(String contextId) {
214    return new IStreamCommand() {
215      @Override
216      public void execute(InputStream inputStream, OutputStream outputStream) throws IOException {
217        // MDCコンテキストを設定
218        MDC.put("requestId", "REQ-" + System.currentTimeMillis());
219        MDC.put("contextId", contextId);
220        MDC.put("threadName", Thread.currentThread().getName());
221        MDC.put("pipelineStage", "setup");
222
223        logger.info("MDC setup command executed - context established");
224
225        // データをそのまま次のステージに渡す
226        inputStream.transferTo(outputStream);
227      }
228    };
229  }
230
231  /** MDC処理用のコマンドを作成 */
232  private static IStreamCommand createMDCProcessingCommand(String stageName) {
233    return new IStreamCommand() {
234      @Override
235      public void execute(InputStream inputStream, OutputStream outputStream) throws IOException {
236        // 現在のMDC状態を確認
237        String requestId = MDC.get("requestId");
238        // ステージ固有の情報を追加
239        MDC.put("pipelineStage", stageName);
240        MDC.put("stageThreadName", Thread.currentThread().getName());
241
242        if (requestId != null) {
243          logger.info("Processing stage {} with inherited requestId: {}", stageName, requestId);
244        } else {
245          logger.warn("Processing stage {} without inherited requestId", stageName);
246        }
247
248        logger.info("Stage {} processing data", stageName);
249
250        // 簡単な処理をシミュレート
251        byte[] buffer = new byte[1024];
252        int bytesRead;
253        while ((bytesRead = inputStream.read(buffer)) != -1) {
254          outputStream.write(buffer, 0, bytesRead);
255        }
256
257        logger.info("Stage {} completed", stageName);
258      }
259    };
260  }
261
262  /** MDCクリーンアップ用のコマンドを作成 */
263  private static IStreamCommand createMDCCleanupCommand() {
264    return new IStreamCommand() {
265      @Override
266      public void execute(InputStream inputStream, OutputStream outputStream) throws IOException {
267        logger.info("MDC cleanup command started");
268
269        // データを最終出力に渡す
270        inputStream.transferTo(outputStream);
271
272        // MDCをクリア
273        MDC.clear();
274        logger.info("MDC cleanup command completed - all context cleared");
275      }
276    };
277  }
278}
